Subject: Renewal pricing and mid-contract growth alignment

Hi Sergio,

We are coming up on our renewal in January and we expect a material increase in usage due to a pilot expansion across three teams. Procurement asked me to check whether we can co-term and include a mid-contract top-up path that avoids a full repricing at renewal.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood provide a staged uplift option (6 months) that blends our current rate with a growth discount?
- What level of commitment is needed to preserve the current volume discount?
- Can you share an illustrative price model we can show our finance team?

I attached the latest SOW for context. Procurement will want the PO timeline and any contract amendments up front.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Stone
Head of Platform Integrations
Nebula Health

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing and mid-contract growth alignment

Emma — thanks for the context and the SOW. We can definitely structure something that gives Nebula runway for growth without forcing a full repricing midterm. High-level options below; I attached a working model (pricing_model_v3.xlsx) with the math.

Option A — Phased Top-up (6 months):
- Immediate reserve: 20% uplift on current commit, billed monthly for 6 months.
- If usage exceeds reserve by end of month 6, the remainder converts at a blended uplift rate (current rate + 12% discount to list).
- Keeps renewal co-term simple; no retroactive charges.

Option B — Voucher Buffer:
- Purchase incremental voucher pool at a 10% discount; vouchers consumed against spike usage.
- Unused vouchers can be applied toward renewal credit.

Option C — Canary Offer (pilot expansion path):
- Short-term price protection for two pilot teams for 90 days at current rate, with capped overage pricing and committed conversion terms if pilot scales.

We can run these numbers against your expected growth profile — can you share monthly usage estimates for the next 6 months and preferred PO timing?

Attach: pricing_model_v3.xlsx

If it helps, I can loop Finance for a quick approvals check. Ben — can you confirm the floor discount we can extend for a staged top-up? Marissa — any legal amends we should prep for a 6-month amendment vs. standalone addendum?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)]
